sections.appearance: Makoto is 169 cm and she has really long, messy, white hair that reach to her feet, with some strands framing her face and a voluminous style at the ends. Her bangs cover her right eye. Her eyes are blue colored. She has 4 symmetrical horns that rise from her head, arching backwards with a curve before tapering to sharp points. Halo ==== Makoto's halo have a plus shape with sharp edges and a asymmetric three quarter circle. The halo is red colored, but it goes to a blood black at the edges. Uniform ==== Makoto wear a military-style uniform, above the military-style uniform, she wear a long and baggy black and red military coat, with gold accents, and epaulettes. The military coat have red sleeves. And underneath the military-style uniform, she wear a white shirt with a black tie. She wear a black skirt, that is decored with golden buttons and have 2 red lines. She wear black sheer hosiery, and black boots. The outfit is completed with a matching military hat adorned with a emblem of a bandage with bat-like wings. Firearm ==== She uses a gold Walther WA 2000 sniper rifle with a black handguard and cheekrest. It is outfitted with a Schmidt & Bender 2.5-10x riflescope. For her EX skill, she commands a battery of 8.8cm Flak 18 guns.

sections.personality: Makoto is an immature and dimwitted tyrant who puts her own passions first. Although her attitude often causes Makoto to suffer and fail, she is a strong-willed girl who quickly recovers. She loves Ibuki like a younger sister, and also treats Iroha like one as well. She also likes to bully Sorasaki Hina and her organization, the Disciplinary Committee, for petty reasons.
